# spec/source/load

`spec/source/load` — a contract's sources, found, confined, pinned and
read. Each source the contract declares (and the one RFC `source.rfc`
names, when no `source.main` picks another) is located (sourceCandidate),
read only if it is spec text (sourceReadConfined), checked against the file
it records and the SHA-256 it pins, refused if it hides text from the gates
(hidden; an RFC's line-break hints are dropped first, hiddenDropBreaks),
and read into its sections by the reader its extension selects, whose
decoded text is checked for hidden text again (an XML reader turns
`&#1058;` into a Cyrillic Т the raw bytes never showed).
Every problem is collected, so one run names them all.

Generated from [src/spec/source/load.ts](https://github.com/amritk/vector/blob/main/src/spec/source/load.ts).

### sourceReadersAdd

Registers a reader for an extension, replacing one already there.

```ts
function sourceReadersAdd(
  readers: SourceReaders,
  ext: string,
  kind: SourceReaderKind,
): Result<boolean, string>
```

<scalar-field name="readers" type="SourceReaders" required>

the registry

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="ext" type="string" required>

the extension, with its leading dot: ".xml"

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="kind" type="SourceReaderKind" required>

the format files with that extension are read as

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="returns" type="Result&lt;boolean, string&gt;">

`Ok(true)` when registered, `Err` when `ext` is not one leading dot
  and a name without another dot or a slash (sourceReaderFor could never
  select it). A caller must check it: on `Err` nothing is registered, and
  a source with that extension stays unreadable.

</scalar-field>

### sourceReadersDefault

The readers every load has: an RFC's plain text, `.txt`, and the XML of an
RFC or a spec, `.xml`. Every command builds its readers from this one
place, so none can forget a source format; sourceReadersAdd adds or
replaces one.

```ts
function sourceReadersDefault(): SourceReaders
```

<scalar-field name="returns" type="SourceReaders">

a registry holding `.txt` and `.xml`

</scalar-field>

### sourceDecodedProblem

Why a document's text, as its reader decoded it, hides text from the gates:
the hidden-text check (hiddenProblem) run on every section's title, lines
and own lines, since a reader that decodes escapes (`&#1058;` to a Cyrillic
Т) can make what its raw bytes never showed.

```ts
function sourceDecodedProblem(doc: RfcDocument, shown: string): string | null
```

<scalar-field name="doc" type="RfcDocument" required>

the document a reader returned

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="shown" type="string" required>

what messages call the source

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="returns" type="string | null">

the problem, or null when the decoded text hides nothing

</scalar-field>

### sourceLoadWith

Reads every source a contract declares (sourceDecls). A file is read only
if it is spec text (sourceReadConfined); it must be the file its `file`
records and match the SHA-256 it pins (the main source may pin it on
`source.sha256` instead), hide nothing from the gates, be read by the reader
its extension selects, and, when the declaration gives an RFC number, be
that RFC.

```ts
function sourceLoadWith(
  contract: Contract,
  contractPath: string,
  root: string,
  readers: SourceReaders,
): SourceSet
```

<scalar-field name="contract" type="Contract" required>

the contract

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="contractPath" type="string" required>

the contract's own path, which `path` is relative to

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="root" type="string" required>

the install root, whose rfcs/ is searched third (before the
  current directory's), and whose specs/ and rfcs/ a source may be read from

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="readers" type="SourceReaders" required>

the readers, by extension

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="returns" type="SourceSet">

the sources read, and a problem for each one that was not

</scalar-field>
